why: Lets a negative held span through instead of refusing it. A span that ends before it starts is a contradiction, and the only reason the cross-seed pairing defect survived from #359 to now is that the numbers it produced were merely low -- a median absorbs them. This guard is what turns the next such pairing into a stop rather than a quietly wrong tuning input.
killedBy: spans are scoped to one seed REFUSES a negative span rather than reporting it
